title: Geo-telemetry fusion & graceful-model-fallback playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a telemetry-fusion based region selection service that combines short-term latency percentiles (p50/p95), active synthetic probe health, and network path-loss indicators to produce a stability score per POP. The service must cross-reference available model variants (full FP16, int8-quant, small-context/fast model) and select a routing policy that meets per-tenant latency SLOs while minimizing cost and preserving correctness. Deliver a deployable policy engine, rollout plan, and dashboard for ops.
acceptance_criteria: Service exposes per-pop stability_score (0..100) updated at 10s cadence
Region selection decision reduces p95 tail by >=8% for affected workloads in canary compared to baseline
Fallback rate to lower-cost model variants is <5% under normal load and gracefully increases during network degradation
Canary rollout with subset of tenants and automatic rollback if error-rate or hallucination metrics exceed threshold
Documentation and runbook linked from ticket; observability panels show score decomposition (latency p50/p95, probe RTT, packet-loss metric)
design_notes: Use EWMA smoothing for p50 and p95 with separate time constants (p50: 30s, p95: 120s) to avoid oscillation
Compute stability_score as weighted fusion: 50% p95 normalized against SLO, 20% p50 drift, 20% active probe failure penalty, 10% packet-loss multiplier
Introduce hysteresis windows and a decay TTL to prevent flip-flopping during transient spikes
Model-variant affinity table: prefer same-architecture variants first (e.g., fp16 -> quantized fp16), avoid switching families unless POP is degraded >30s
Cost-aware routing: factor estimated per-token cost delta into decision when stability_score is borderline
Expose debug trace in headers for selected requests and log decisions to tracing backend for later analysis
implementation_plan: Schema: add per-pop metrics stream in telemetry pipeline with tags {pop, region, model_variant}
Service: build a stateless scorer that subscribes to metrics and publishes stability_score to config-store (10s cadence)
Routing: update region-decider to consult stability_score and variant-affinity table, fall back to next-best variant when score < threshold
Testing: unit tests for scorer math, integration tests with synthetic probe failure modes, end-to-end canary with 5 tenants
Observability: new Grafana panels and alerts for stability_score drops, increased fallback-rate, and model-variant churn
Rollout: internal canary -> staged tenant rollout -> 100% with automatic rollback policy
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: oscillation if p95 updates too frequently. Mitigation: separate time constants, hysteresis, and minimum evaluation windows
Risk: model-quality regressions after variant fallback. Mitigation: tie fallback decisions to quality monitors and limit guessing for hallucination-prone prompts
Risk: noisy probe data from edge. Mitigation: blend active probes with real-request telemetry and apply outlier rejection
Risk: increased complexity leading to debugging difficulty. Mitigation: include per-request decision traces and a /routing/debug endpoint
test_plan: Load test with synthetic 2x traffic and induced network-loss to observe fallback escalation
Chaos test: drop connectivity to one POP for 60s and validate region-decider moves traffic smoothly and returns when healthy
Quality evaluation: run regression evals on fallback variants for representative prompt set and assert constrained quality drop (<6% BLEU/semantic-similarity percentile)
A/B: run 10% production traffic for 48h comparing baseline vs new policy, monitor p50/p95 and cost-per-1k tokens
rollout_steps: Deploy scorer to staging, validate metrics and stability_score calculations
Internal canary: route internal-dev tenants for 24h, gather traces and adjust weights
Customer canary: 5 production tenants (low-margin), 48h, monitor SLOs and fallback-rate
Gradual scale: increase to 25% traffic for 72h if no regressions
Full rollout with automated rollback if SLO violations > threshold
